title: Chapter 132 Humble Heaven
content:
Chapter 132 Humble Heaven

At this time, A Wei slowly walked towards here from a distance.

Seeing Xiao Yun'er beside An Xing, A Wei's expression was slightly stunned, but then he returned to normal.

"An Xing, you are finally back."

"Your leave is long enough."

A Wei looked at An Xing and said indifferently.

Hearing this, An Xing looked apologetic and smiled awkwardly: "Sorry, Brother Wei."

He really had something to do, but he was really responsible for delaying the business.

"Yun'er, this is A Wei, the most trusted subordinate of the city lord."

An Xing turned his head and introduced Xiao Yun'er.

Hearing this, Xiao Yun'er's expression was shocked, and the look she gave A Wei suddenly became more shocked.

The most trusted subordinate of the city lord!

The name of Lu Daosheng, the lord of the deserted city, is famous throughout the Hongmeng universe.

Build a deserted city, destroy alien races, and open up the passage to the upper world.

As a person from the Hongmeng Universe, she naturally knew it all.

I didn't expect that the man in front of her had such great power in the deserted city.

"My name is Xiao Yun'er, and I come from the Yunhai Galaxy of the Hongmeng Universe."

At this time, Xiao Yun'er nodded to Awei.

At this time, Awei was still immersed in An Xing's words just now.

As the most trusted subordinate of the city lord, it must be said that Awei liked to hear this sentence very much.

At this moment, Awei also forgave An Xing in his heart for asking for leave to pick up girls.

"Brother Wei?"

Seeing that Awei didn't move, An Xing stepped forward and poked Awei.

Immediately, Awei reacted and said, "Oh, everyone is from the Hongmeng Universe, so there's no need to be polite."

Then, Awei was about to take everyone into the house for a meeting.

At this time, several figures slowly emerged from the scene. They were the confidants around An Xing and the top members of the root organization.

Each of them is an extremely terrifying existence in the deserted city, which can be said to be daunting.

At this time, these people saluted An Xing with extremely respectful expressions.

"My lord, you are back."

An Xing glanced at them calmly, nodded, and said, "Follow me in."

"Yes, my lord."

At this time, An Xing turned his head to look at Xiao Yun'er, and his face instantly became extremely gentle.

"Yun'er, follow me in, I won't hide anything from you."

Hearing this, Xiao Yun'er was silent.

After a moment, Xiao Yun'er shook her head.

"Xiao An, I won't go in."

"I know you won't hide it from me, but that's your job, I don't want to drag you down."

Obviously, she has seen something.

Hearing this, An Xing was stunned.

"Yun'er, you..."

At this time, Xiao Yun'er suddenly came up and pecked at the corner of An Xing's mouth like a dragonfly.

"Xiao An, you have your own things to do, I won't join in the fun, I'll wait for you outside."

Looking at Xiao Yun'er's refreshing and slightly rosy smile.

An Xing's heart melted completely at this moment.

He swore that he would spend his whole life to protect the woman in front of him!

In the distance, Ah Wei looked at this scene, a gratified smile appeared on his face, and then he also thought of his wife at home.

As for Gu Chen on the side.

As a single dog, he silently endured 10,000 points of critical strikes.

Why do you treat him like this!

Muxian Realm.

A figure slowly emerged from the void.

Looking at the scene below, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

This time he finally did not come to the wrong place.

Muxian Realm, at this moment, he has already felt the breath that Yan Lingyun once left here.

Thinking of his wife, Lu Daosheng sighed softly.

He wanted to bear everything alone. If he hadn't activated the system, his wife would not know how much grievance she would have suffered.

Then, Lu Daosheng sat cross-legged in the void.

The next moment, countless dense runes slowly emerged in front of him.

After a long time, Lu Daosheng slowly opened his eyes.

Then a faint murderous intent gradually spread from his body.

Boom!

Suddenly, the entire void was directly shattered into nothingness.

At the same time, the sky instantly turned blood red, and the murderous intent seemed to have become substantial.

Countless strong men looked in this direction in horror.

Why does this breath have a familiar feeling.

On the spot, Lu Daosheng stood up, and then clenched his right hand into a fist.

With a roar.

The origin of the entire Wood Immortal Realm was affected.

"Stop it!"

An angry voice sounded in the void.

The next moment, a shadow slowly emerged not far in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Do you want to destroy the entire Wood Immortal Realm?"

The shadow questioned Lu Daosheng.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's expression did not change, and he said calmly: "So what, can you stop me?"

Hearing this, the shadow suddenly fell silent.

After a moment, the shadow hesitated and said: "Can't we discuss it again?"

Lu Daosheng sneered, and then waved his hand, and the shadow was immediately grasped by Lu Daosheng.

Feeling Lu Daosheng's terrifying and desperate power, the shadow was trembling with fear.

"Big, big boss, think twice!"

At this moment, the entire Wood Immortal Realm was shaking wildly.

Countless rules of power were even more chaotic like crazy.

Feeling the abnormal movement of the world, countless top powerhouses were horrified.

"This, this is?!"

"Something happened to Tiandao!"

"Tiandao, what happened to Tiandao?"

For a moment, all the top masters panicked.

The Tiandao of the Wood Immortal Realm is the origin of the Wood Immortal Realm. Once something happens to Tiandao, the entire Wood Immortal Realm will be completely ruined.

In the void, Lu Daosheng looked at Tiandao who was still begging for mercy in his hand, and after a moment of silence, he slowly said: "Please do me a favor."

Hearing this, Tiandao suddenly couldn't believe his ears.

Please? ? ?

Listen to what people say?

Is there anyone who asks for help like this?

However, looking at Lu Daosheng's serious face, Tiandao didn't dare to say much, and hurriedly said: "Just give me your orders, boss!"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, and then asked: "Do you know Yan Lingyun?"

Hearing the three words Yan Lingyun, Tiandao was immediately puzzled.

Who is this?

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng was stunned, and then raised his empty hand, and a beautiful figure emerged from his hand.

It was Yan Lingyun.

"I ask you, do you know this woman?"

Seeing Yan Lingyun, Tiandao trembled for a moment.

"It's her!"

Seeing Tiandao's reaction, Lu Daosheng was not surprised and continued: "Tell me what happened after she came to the Wood Immortal Realm, don't miss any details."

Hearing this, Tiandao hesitated and said: "Boss, I know you are very strong, but the cause and effect involved in this matter is a bit big,"

As soon as this was said, Lu Daosheng laughed.

"Are you afraid that I can't bear this cause and effect?"

Tiandao was silent.

He couldn't bear this cause and effect. What he cared about most was whether Lu Daosheng could block this cause and effect for him after he said it.

Otherwise, it would not only be Lu Daosheng who would be in trouble, but he would also be implicated.

Seeing Tiandao like this, Lu Daosheng paused slightly, and the next moment, the power in his hand gradually changed.

Buzz——

In an instant, Tiandao trembled all over, and at this moment, he felt unprecedented comfort.

At the same time, the entire Wood Immortal Realm also stabilized, and countless powerful energies continued to gather, giving the appearance of a great revival of all things.

"Boss, you!!"

Tiandao, who had reacted, immediately looked at Lu Daosheng excitedly.

This method was unprecedented!
